section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种生物基因检测探针，包括探针壳体和探头，所述探针壳体的下端开设有圆形凹槽，所述圆形凹槽内滑动连接有活动杆，且圆形凹槽内壁上设置有与活动杆连接的限位机构，所述活动杆的下端延伸至探针壳体的下侧，且探头对应连接在活动杆的下端，且活动杆的下端开设有与探头对应的安装槽，所述探头的下端开设有与安装槽连通的细孔，所述安装槽内壁上固定连接有感应器，所述活动杆的上端开设有与安装槽连通的线路孔。本实用新型能够避免探头使用时出现反复交叉检测的情况，进而能够保证基因检测时的数据精确性，有助于后续的数据分析，并且可以根据检测使用的需要对探头的长度进行调节，提高检测的精确度。

The utility model discloses a biological gene detection probe, including probe casing and probe, circular recess has been seted up to probe casing's lower extreme, sliding connection has the movable rod in the circular recess, and is provided with the stop gear who is connected with the movable rod on the circular recess inner wall, the lower extreme of movable rod extends to probe casing's downside, and the probe correspondence connects the lower extreme at the movable rod, and the lower extreme of movable rod sets up the mounting groove that corresponds with the probe, the pore with the mounting groove intercommunication is seted up to the lower extreme of probe, fixedly connected with inductor on the mounting groove inner wall, the circuit hole with the mounting groove intercommunication is seted up to the upper end of movable rod. The utility model discloses the condition that appears relapseing cross detection when can avoiding the probe to use, and then can guarantee the data accuracy nature of gene detection time, help subsequent data analysis to can adjust the length of probe according to the needs that detect the use, improve the accuracy that detects.

Biological gene detection probeTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a gene detection technical field especially relates to a biological gene detection probe.

Background

The accurate measurement of the thermophysical parameters of the organism is a basic parameter for the biophysical research, and has important significance for modeling and checking the biological heat and mass transfer process, thermal response of biological tissues under the action of a heat source, reconstruction of an organism temperature field and the like, and particularly has wide application backgrounds in clinical medicine, such as tumor thermotherapy, which needs to know the temperature distribution and the change of a treatment part in real time so as to reasonably organize the heat source and determine the heating dose, therefore, a computer numerical simulation method is usually adopted.

The existing detection probe is usually used repeatedly, so that data deviation caused by incomplete cleaning is easily caused, the length of the detection probe is mostly fixed, the use length of the detection probe is not convenient to adjust, and therefore, a biological gene detection probe is provided to solve the problems.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims at solving the defects existing in the prior art and providing a biological gene detection probe.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical scheme:

a biological gene detection probe comprises a probe shell and a probe head, wherein the lower end of the probe shell is provided with a circular groove, a movable rod is connected in the circular groove in a sliding way, and the inner wall of the circular groove is provided with a limiting mechanism connected with the movable rod, the lower end of the movable rod extends to the lower side of the probe shell, the probe is correspondingly connected with the lower end of the movable rod, the lower end of the movable rod is provided with an installation groove corresponding to the probe, the lower end of the probe is provided with a pore communicated with the mounting groove, the inner wall of the mounting groove is fixedly connected with an inductor, the upper end of the movable rod is provided with a circuit hole communicated with the mounting groove, a cavity is arranged in the probe shell on the upper side of the circular groove, and a sensing device is fixedly connected in the cavity, the sensing device is connected with the inductor through a wire, and an installation mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the probe shell.

Preferably, sensing device and outside computer end wireless connection, the response paster has been placed to the lower extreme of inductor, and the response paster contacts with biological detection solution and is connected.

Preferably, the probe is made of disposable PVC material, and the induction patch is also disposable.

Preferably, the upper end fixedly connected with of probe corresponds with the mounting groove screwed pipe, and screwed pipe and mounting groove inner wall threaded connection, the screwed pipe corresponds the cup joint in the outside of pore.

Preferably, stop gear includes the stopper of fixed connection on the movable rod lateral wall, set up the spacing groove with stopper sliding connection on the circular recess inner wall, threaded connection has the fastening knob fixed with the movable rod on the lateral wall of probe casing.

Preferably, installation mechanism includes that a plurality of equipartitions are seted up in the bar groove of probe casing upper end, and bar inslot sliding connection has the bar piece, by bolt fixed connection, it is a plurality of between bar piece and the bar groove the same mounting panel of upper end fixedly connected with of bar piece, and the upper end equipartition of mounting panel has a plurality of mounting holes that communicate from top to bottom.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that:

1. the probe in the utility model is made of disposable PVC materials, so that the repeated cross detection condition can be avoided when the probe is used, and the data accuracy during gene detection can be ensured, thereby facilitating subsequent data analysis.

2. The installation mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the probe shell, so that the probe shell and external equipment can be conveniently installed and fixed, and the using length of the probe shell can be correspondingly finely adjusted, so that the accuracy in detection is improved.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a schematic structural diagram of a bio-gene detection probe according to the present invention;

FIG. 2 is an enlarged view of a portion of FIG. 1 at A;

FIG. 3 is a schematic top view of a strip-shaped block of the bio-gene detection probe according to the present invention.

In the figure: the probe comprises a probe shell 1, a probe 2, a movable rod 3, a pore 4, an inductor 5, a sensing device 6, an electric wire 7, a threaded pipe 8, a limiting block 9, a limiting groove 10, a strip-shaped block 11, a bolt 12 and a mounting plate 13.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments.

Referring to fig. 1-3, a biological gene detection probe, including probe casing 1 and probe 2, circular recess has been seted up to the lower extreme of probe casing 1, sliding connection has movable rod 3 in the circular recess, and be provided with the stop gear who is connected with movable rod 3 on the circular recess inner wall, stop gear includes stopper 9 of fixed connection on movable rod 3 lateral wall, set up on the circular recess inner wall with stopper 9 sliding connection's spacing groove 10, threaded connection has the fastening knob fixed with movable rod 3 on the lateral wall of probe casing 1, can carry out corresponding regulation according to the height of probe 2 when using, satisfy the operation requirement under the different situation.

Wherein, the lower end of the movable rod 3 extends to the lower side of the probe shell 1, the probe 2 is correspondingly connected with the lower end of the movable rod 3, the lower end of the movable rod 3 is provided with a mounting groove corresponding to the probe 2, the lower end of the probe 2 is provided with a pore 4 communicated with the mounting groove, the inner wall of the mounting groove is fixedly connected with an inductor 5, the upper end of the movable rod 3 is provided with a circuit hole communicated with the mounting groove, the probe shell 1 at the upper side of the circular groove is internally provided with a cavity, the cavity is internally and fixedly connected with a sensing device 6, the sensing device 6 is connected with the inductor 5 through an electric wire 7, the sensing device 6 is wirelessly connected with an external computer end, the lower end of the inductor 5 is provided with a sensing patch, the sensing patch is in contact connection with the biological detection solution, concretely, the probe 2 is made of disposable PVC material, the sensing patch is, the condition of cross detection appears repeatedly when can avoiding probe 2 to use, when needs use the probe device to examine time measuring, install disposable probe 2 at the lower extreme of movable rod 3, pore 4 of probe 2 lower extreme can carry the biological solution that needs to detect to the mounting groove in and make it and response paster contact, and then inductor 5 can be real-time detect solution and with data transfer to sensing device 6 in, transmit data to the computer end by sensing device 6 again, and is concrete, sensing device 6 and inductor 5 are prior art product, no longer describe herein repeatedly.

Wherein, probe housing 1's upper end is provided with installation mechanism, installation mechanism includes that a plurality of equipartitions are seted up in the bar groove of probe housing 1 upper end, and bar inslot sliding connection has bar piece 11, by bolt 12 fixed connection between bar piece 11 and the bar groove, the same mounting panel 13 of the upper end fixedly connected with of a plurality of bar pieces 11, and mounting panel 13's upper end equipartition has a plurality of mounting holes that communicate from top to bottom, be provided with installation mechanism through the upper end at probe housing 1, be convenient for probe housing 1 installs fixedly with outside equipment, and can carry out corresponding fine setting to probe housing 1's service length, in order to improve the accuracy of detecting time measuring.

In the utility model, the probe 2 is made of disposable PVC material, which can avoid the repeated cross detection when the probe 2 is used, further ensuring the data accuracy in gene detection, when a probe device is needed for detection, a disposable probe 2 is arranged at the lower end of the movable rod 3, a pore 4 at the lower end of the probe 2 can convey the biological solution to be detected into the mounting groove and make the biological solution contact with the induction patch, the sensor 5 can detect the solution in real time and transmit the data to the sensing device 6, and then the sensing device 6 transmits the data to the computer end, which is helpful for the subsequent data analysis, and the upper end of the probe shell 1 is provided with the mounting mechanism, so that the probe shell 1 can be conveniently mounted and fixed with external equipment, and the used length of the probe shell 1 can be adjusted finely correspondingly to improve the accuracy in detection.

The above, only be the concrete implementation of the preferred embodiment of the present invention, but the protection scope of the present invention is not limited thereto, and any person skilled in the art is in the technical scope of the present invention, according to the technical solution of the present invention and the utility model, the concept of which is equivalent to replace or change, should be covered within the protection scope of the present invention.
